nodes.title: Guard hypothesis-revision release on its currently stored state
nodes.summary: RelationalCaseStore's releaseHypothesisRevisionRow now reads the revision's own current state before writing and refuses with HypothesisRevisionNotDraftAtReleaseError unless that state is draft, including when no row was ever stored.

nodes.title: Guard hypothesis-revision release on its currently stored state
nodes.summary: Proves that releaseHypothesisRevisionRow refuses release with HypothesisRevisionNotDraftAtReleaseError whenever the revision's own current state is not draft — including an identity never stored — leaves the row untouched on refusal, succeeds and marks the row released when the state is draft, and raises the refusal identically across both triggering branches.
